name: standing back extension hold
description: A gentle standing back-extension hold with the hands supporting the lower back. It moves the spine out of a flexed posture.
instructions: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and soften your knees.
Place your hands on the back of your hips for support.
Lift your chest and lean back only a small, comfortable amount, letting your gaze rise naturally.
Hold briefly while breathing, then return to an upright stance.
